text: Figure 2 (key result R1): left panel HCN/HCO+ 3-2 T_b ratio of N, S (and Bridge) versus beam size from 0.26" (50 pc) to 6.5" (50, 55, 120, 250 pc Xb4b; 250 pc Xb4d; 6.5" Xb4d and Xb4f as separate symbols), error bars stat, grey band for 14% flux scale; annotate N/S contrast (2.1+-0.2 at 50-120 pc, 1.9 at 250 pc, 1.07-1.10 at 6.5"). Right panel: peak T_b (K) of HCN and HCO+ at N and S vs beam (same x-axis), showing HCO+ equal and HCN 2x lower at S. Use the estimator behind s171_summary (aperture r=beam FWHM) and say so; mention estimator spread 1.9-2.3 in caption. Optionally inset: ratio vs radius in N (0.39 at 2-3" to 0.97 inside 0.25") and S (flat) at 0.30".
